name: Transcription factors (mouse)
description: A mouse transcription-factor list built on 2026-11-03, since no curated mouse census exists: MGI orthologs of the 1,556-TF human Codebook census (1,339 genes), plus CIS-BP 3.10 mouse TFs with no human ortholog (120: Rhox, Obox, Duxbl, mouse Zfp expansions), plus 17 CIS-BP-only genes whose human ortholog was never assessed, kept for review; 3 absent from the shipped GENCODE table are left out. All TFs is the list; the folders split it by DNA-binding domain (a gene with two domains is in both) and by provenance. Known gap: the mouse KRAB-Zfp expansion is only partly covered.
